name: Carousell (Singapore)

scam_info.notes: Carousell Help Centre (Zendesk). Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge to curl; one WebFetch attempt also HTTP 403. Contents (safety/scam articles) not seen. robots.txt (200) disallows /requests, /registration etc.; /hc articles not disallowed.

notes: blocked: www.carousell.sg and support.carousell.com return Cloudflare JS challenge (HTTP 403) to curl; WebFetch on support.carousell.com/hc/en-us also 403. Stopped (no archives/caches). official_domains: carousell.sg and carousell.com are (b) the domains serving the marketplace (robots.txt 200) and help centre (support.carousell.com), and are stated as the only Carousell domains in SPF advisory 2022-12-28 (police.gov.sg, opened): 'Only domains that end with carousell.com or carousell.sg are Carousell domains. URLs such as carousellpay.com, carousell.xxx.com, carousell-pay.com, carousell.pay-sg.com are NOT Carousell domains. Carousell does not send links via SMS, and would only send OTPs via SMS.' Same SPF advisory cites example phishing URLs cutt.ly/31uXCDu, carousell.quick-funds.in/266780736 and a spoofed sender ID with uppercase 'I' + lowercase 'l' (fake; text only, never visited) - these are SPF-published, not Carousell-published. Sector 'marketplace' (C2C classifieds). Carousell's own scam pages could not be read, so no Carousell-side scam_info detail.
